text:
zara: FYI, bumped into legal — they want clear wording for "soft burst" in contracts before we include it in roadmap.
sam: ok. we need a short, customer-facing sentence + a technical appendix. legal concerns: define guarantees vs best-effort.
leila: draft wording suggestion: "Soft Burst: Customers receive a configurable temporary headroom for traffic spikes. Soft Burst is subject to capacity availability and may be degraded during systemic congestion; premium plans can contract higher guaranteed headroom backed by prewarm slots."
chen: technical note: guarantee only possible if we back with prewarm slots. Otherwise it's a "latency-aware best effort" with admission controls and fairshare.
deepa: ops: runbook must show how we detect systemic congestion and the exact steps to degrade gracefully (throttle, fallback model, cross-region spill). Also need an ops-derived SLA veto signal.
evan_sales: ACME will ask for example numbers. can we propose default tiers (elastic 10%/24h, premium 30%/24h w/prewarm, enterprise custom)?
zara: legal wants a definitions table + example failure scenarios for the SLA. we should include abort criteria for rollout.
sam: rollout proposal: staged enable per-tenant, opt-in for beta, pilot 4 weeks, GA with visible opt-in toggle + invoice line-item. abort if >4% customers exceed p99 target or cost delta >25%.
leila: telemetry items: per-tenant p50/p90/p99, burst_ru_used, prewarm_gpu_hours, eviction_count, fallback_count.
chen: infra tasks: simulate 30-day traces for top tenants; model cost for prewarm-backed premium plan. need data by Wed.
deepa: ops alarms: queue_p95 > 250ms sustained 90s => trigger circuit-breaker. when fired runbook does: 1) reduce surge admission for non-critical tenants 2) promote fallback routing 3) notify CS and ops. include automatic per-tenant disable button.
evan_sales: for pricing we need visibility into expected prewarm GPU-hours per 1k RU commit, and a sample invoice mock. i'll draft partner pricing lanes.
zara: small nit: legal wants "Guaranteed" only used when prewarm-backed and contractually committed. otherwise use "Burst Priority" wording.
sam: agreed. change public docs to use "Burst Priority" for default and reserve "Guaranteed Burst" for prewarm-backed paid plans.
leila: quality gate: no >2% regression on customer eval sets during surge for pilots. include rerun evals weekly during beta.
chen: config proto for policy (v0):
```
policy_name: reserved_burst_v0
burst_window: 24h
default_burst_pct: 10
premium_burst_pct: 30
prewarm_slots_per_1000RU: 2
concurrent_slots_cap: 4
fallbacks: model_variant | regional_spill
```
evan_sales: ACME & ByteBank are interested in premium pilot. i'll coordinate legal and get NDA signed.
zara: i'll assemble contract language + examples and post by Thu.
sam: owners: leila=telemetry/UI, chen=sim+config, deepa=runbook+ops signals, zara=contract/legal, evan_sales=pilot sales. reconvene Fri 8:30am PT. ops-bot: Canary scheduled for policy "reserved_burst_v0" on staging at 2024-10-02T03:00Z.
sam: thanks everyone — feel free to ping in thread for blockers. :rocket:
